name: B. Robertson
story: B. Robertson wrote Hastings District Council’s 1999 paper on predicting and mapping fire spread. A 2009 Scion review cites that paper in its account of Firesim, a GenaMap application for wildfire simulation and planning.

The review points back to two 1999 council sources, including a paper by B. Robertson in the Resource Management Division's Office of Emergency Management. Hastings used GenaMap for fire prediction and council spatial data.
